subject: Will anything terrible happen if I use multiple `navbarPage`?

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Will anything terrible happen if I use multiple `navbarPage`?
parts:
It looks like `navbarPage` is meant to be used as a top-level navigation, and only meant to exist once per app. The fact that it has a "windowTitle" parameter makes that fairly clear.

In my app I'm already using navbarPage as my main navbar. However, there's another place where I want to have tabbed content, and I would like to have a "title" appear to the left of the tabs - just like navbarPage does. I wasn't sure what's a cleaner solution: use a navbarPage which natively supports having a title next to the tabs but it'd mean having 2 navbarPages, or just hack the CSS to get some element to show up inline with the tabs?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Will anything terrible happen if I use multiple `navbarPage`?
parts: I'd personally do the latter, but wrap it up in an R function much like navbarPage, say tabsetWithTitle. Having two navbars would be a weird user experience, I think.
